name: Haven
short: Reversible lockdown and separately confirmed owner-only destructive reset
description: Seal/restore provides reversible read-only mode. Nuke requires both guild and bot ownership, pauses invites, removes other members' assignable roles, and permanently deletes old channels, leaving a private owner channel.
end_user_data_statement: Stores overwrite snapshots, delegate IDs, and local reset audit files containing actor/member/role/channel IDs, channel names, role assignments, and operation results. Reset logs persist in the Haven cog data directory until the operator removes them. No message contents or invite codes are stored.
install_msg: Read haven/README.md. [p]haven nuke preview is read-only. [p]haven nuke requires explicit confirmation and permanently deletes channels/messages; haven restore cannot undo it. Both guild and bot ownership are required.
